descriptionChirho: To break, crush, or shatter something by physical force, used of breaking an alabaster jar (Mark 14:3), a demon convulsing and bruising a person (Luke 9:39), or God crushing Satan underfoot (Rom 16:20).

To be broken, crushed, or shattered, in either a literal sense (chains being smashed, Mark 5:4; vessels shattered, Rev 2:27) or a figurative sense (a bruised reed, Matt 12:20; the brokenhearted, Luke 4:18; a bone not being broken, John 19:36).
